C1352.title: GPU Remote Code Execution Attacks: Exploiting Vulnerabilities to Hijack GPU Computing Power
C1352.summary: This academic research provides a comprehensive analysis of remote code execution attacks targeting GPUs, demonstrating methods that exploit GPU firmware or driver vulnerabilities to execute malicious code on a target system. Attackers can leverage these vulnerabilities to illicitly gain control of a victim's GPU computing resources for cryptocurrency mining or other computationally intensive task
